blocks.tamil_translation: will be brought; no Mizan (scale) will be set up for them, nor will a court be held. Reward and recompense will be poured upon them like rain. Those who lived in comfort in the world (on seeing these excellent rewards) will wish, “If only our bodies had been cut with scissors (in the world), we would have borne it with patience!'” — Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا أَحَبَّ اللهُ قَوْماً اِبْتَلَاَهُمْ، فَمَنْ صَبَرَ فَلَهُ الصَّبْرُ وَمَنْ جَزِعَ فَلَهُ الْجَزَعُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد: ١١/٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “When Allah Ta'ala intends to love a people, He tests them by putting them into hardships. Whoever is patient, patience (its reward) is written for him; whoever is not patient, impatience is written for him” (then he will keep weeping and wailing) — Hazrat Mahmud ibn Labid (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكُونُ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللهِ الْمَنْزِلَةَ فَمَا يَبْلُغُهَا بِعَمَلِهِ، فَمَا يَزَالُ اللهُ يَبْتَلِيهِ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ حَتَّي يَبْلُغَهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو يعلي وفي رواية له: َيَكُونُ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللهِ الْمَنْزِلَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ. ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:٣ /١٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “A high rank is decreed for a person with Allah Ta'ala, (but) if he does not reach that rank through his deeds, Allah Ta'ala tests him (with illnesses, hardships and the like). These are disliked by him, and in the end, through the disliked conditions of that trial, he attains the rank that was his” — the Prophet ﷺ
